title: Response tracking leaves streams intact
summary:
A maintenance day for streaming responses, clearer chat-completion errors, and broader integration checks.

Enter now tracks a copy of each response, so reading usage data does not consume streaming output meant for the caller. Tracking also handles responses without extractable model usage.

Proxy errors now retain the upstream status and use a consistent error format.

Integration tests now cover more text models and audio output, with recorded upstream responses to make those checks more reliable.
